honesty_notes: Host tests prove module correctness on synthetic images, NOT target facts.

The live probe MUST re-walk VMMAP first: Objects**=0x13800220a0 is not covered by the recovered spans (worker-batch2-live-prep verdict); this module makes that re-walk step (a) of the sequence and classifies uncovered addresses as Inconclusive/needs-map, never a guess.
Chunk/object storage addresses beyond the chunk-table pointer are synthetic in fixtures; only the already-validated GUA header set is live-derived.
NamePrivate raw 8B is copied and never interpreted (P2 rule); the commissioning-prompt Outer/Name offset conflict stays recorded, following the cited SET-5_06 setter (Name 0x18 < Outer 0x20).
This is preparation for the NEXT console test; nothing here runs on target.
